rubric.role_summary: Controls Engineer designing and tuning model-based and real-time control systems for robots, including simulation, hardware integration, and electromechanical debugging.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Controls Engineer designing and tuning model-based and real-time control systems for robots, including simulation, hardware integration, and electromechanical debugging.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience with control algorithms.
- Proficiency in Python and C++.
- Skill in writing and tuning real-time control loops.
- Hands-on experience with electromechanical systems.
- Familiarity with embedded communication protocols; CAN, SPI, I2C, and Ethernet are listed examples, not an all-protocol requirement.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Background in manipulation or mobile robotic platforms.
- Exposure to robot learning or integrating learned policies into control stacks.
- Ability to design or refine custom actuator or sensor hardware.
- Deep understanding of model-based control algorithms and inverse dynamics.
- Ability to validate control approaches in simulation and translate them to real hardware.
- Proficiency in Python and C++, including firmware-adjacent development.
- Hands-on capability to debug electromechanical systems end-to-end.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
